blocks.text:
After breakfast, travel to the La Cruz del Cóndor viewpoint. The drive from Chivay takes about 1.5 hours.

From the viewpoint, you can watch condors, whose wingspan reaches 3 metres.

The Colca Canyon is approximately twice as deep as the Grand Canyon in the USA.

After the tour, return to the hotel and depart for Arequipa.

Along the way, stop at viewpoints overlooking 3 volcanoes.

Arrive in Arequipa and check in at a 3* hotel. Free time to explore the city.

The journey through Colca takes almost the whole day and passes through high-altitude landscapes. The main stop in the morning is La Cruz del Cóndor. Here, travellers wait for condors to appear above the canyon and watch the large birds use rising air currents. The road to Arequipa then passes more viewpoints overlooking the volcanoes.

blocks.text: After breakfast, a tour of the White City, a fine example of colonial architecture. Founded by the Spaniards in the 16th century in a fertile valley at more than 2,300 m, surrounded by the Misti, Chachani and Pichu Pichu volcanoes, Arequipa takes its nickname from the white volcanic stone of its buildings, and its historic centre has been a UNESCO World Heritage Site since 2000. Visit the main square, the Yanahuara viewpoint and the Santa Catalina Monastery, founded in the late 16th century, a city within the city of some 20,000 square metres, with a church, galleries, gardens and a gallery of religious art. Transfer to the airport and flight to Lima; transfer to the hotel.
